office_does: The full-time District Court judge presides over the county's court for misdemeanors, traffic infractions, small claims, protection orders and smaller civil cases.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Kristian Hedine is retiring, and part-time Judge Jared N. Hawkins is the only candidate for the full-time seat.

candidates.summary: Walla Walla County District Court's part-time judge since winning the seat in 2022, running unopposed for the full-time seat.
highlights: Won the part-time judgeship in 2022 over Nicholas Holce [S3]
Owned Hawkins Law; Air Force Reserve lieutenant colonel providing legal services (2022 reporting) [S3]
Unopposed for the seat Judge Hedine is vacating [S2][S4]
